offering_description.value: The firm provides scientific and engineering consulting to companies, communities, and individuals. Its consultants use expertise across disciplines and technical testing to investigate failures and solve complex problems.

quotes.quote: Exponent brings together the world's best science and engineering with the most pressing problems facing companies, communities, and individuals. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world.

When you're stuck, when you're facing a never-before-seen issue, when everything's on the line, turn to Exponent. Our consultants leverage multidisciplinary expertise and state-of-the-art testing to unravel complex problems — so you can move ahead with confidence.
